Descrizione:
Even in our 'free' societies, millions of cameras watch us every day
With AI, it is easy to analyze faces and track all your data.
Various researchers have imagined clothes that confuse the algorithm with special patterns. You can find an example here or here.
We have tried to imagine something a little less tripping, even though it probably won't work.

Our protest collar allows you to continuously record what is happening, protecting you and the people around you from excessive law enforcement behavior.
The collar is equipped with memory and real-time image transmission functionality to multiple receivers via wifi and data connection. Up to 10h of uninterrupted recording.
The collar can only be removed with a specific key and is entirely made of carbon to ensure durability and optimal wearability.

With our new Faraday* mosquito net, you can easily avoid mosquitoes and notifications, creating a quality space and time with your partner.
*A Faraday cage is a metal mesh that does not allow electromagnetic waves to pass, preventing any network connection.
